title: Agent Azure Toolset
summary: Independent APIs and ingestion jobs that give AI agents structured access to cloud updates, service status, and a browsable knowledge collection.
description: Agent Azure Toolset supplies deterministic services for tasks that do not need model reasoning. Independently deployable workloads expose blog and service-status feeds through OpenAPI, ingest RSS and CSV data, and make stored knowledge available through an API and web browser.

The ingestion job writes updates and retirement information to Azure Table Storage, using stable identifiers so repeated imports update existing records. A FastAPI proxy reads configured tables and Markdown documents with managed identity, while a React interface presents the collection alongside status incidents and blog posts.

Each workload owns its dependencies, tests, container image, and Azure configuration. Shared code is limited to cross-cutting behavior such as health, logging, and correlation. Server-configured feed sources keep the APIs focused rather than exposing arbitrary URL fetching.

highlights: Deterministic tooling instead of model-driven data processing
Independent services and scheduled ingestion workloads
Managed-identity access to a browsable knowledge collection
